title: Sobolev inequality for compactly supported Lipschitz functions: ‖u‖_{(n+1)/n} ≤ c∫|Du| (Gagliardo-Nirenberg-Sobolev for n ≥ 1, sup|u| ≤ ½∫|u'| for n = 0; parent Step 7 'Constants')
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1, and p := (n + 1)/n computed in ℝ≥0∞ (so p = ∞ when n = 0). There is c > 0 such that every K-Lipschitz u : ℝ^N → ℝ (K ∈ ℝ≥0) with compact support satisfies eLpNorm(u, p, L^N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c ∫ |Du| dL^N), where |Du(y)| = ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ and eLpNorm(·, ∞) is the essential supremum.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (u : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K u → HasCompactSupport u → eLpNorm u ((n + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) / n) volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖)
